title: Castle Daybreak
description:
About Castle DaybreakCastle Daybreak is an indie single-player class-based Action RPG; set in a medieval world on the verge of being overrun by an unrelenting evil.

Unlock powerful and unique abilities for your class! Mix and match Perks and weapons to build the perfect build while climbing through the levels and defeating all the enemies that stand in your way.

 

Class-BasedChoose one of five unique classes to start your adventure, each with their own unique set of abilities. Play as the Rogue, an agile fighter that can quickly dart around the battlefield in an instant. The Guardian brings the heat with destructive AOE abilities and charming little fox for companionship. The Duelist lives for melee combat and specializes in up close and personal conflict resolution. The Vanguard has a wide assortment of abilities, most of which focuses on de-buffing the enemy and staying alive. The Healer, possessing an understanding of healing and medicine, also comprehends the techniques of virulence. The Exalted is the sixth class that is only available after completing a specific achievement in game. This class prioritizes using numerous companions alongside mind-controlling abilities to decimate their foes.

Open WorldExplore the Island of Victoris, a once prosperous island that was destroyed by greed and corruption, shortly followed by a catastrophic event that left the island forever changed.

Explore and grow your power by capturing enemy fortifications, participating in random events scattered through most of the island. Delve into dungeons and reclaim epic loot that will aide in battle.

Instanced DungeonsDungeons are a great way to level up and find new gear and weapons.
description_short: Castle Daybreak is a single-player class-based Action RPG set in a medieval world on the verge of being overrun by an unrelenting evil. Unlock powerful skills, and find new gear, including weapons in the open world or inside instanced dungeons to aid you in making a stand against the tides of evil.
